title: Promote winner checkpoint to models/
description: Copy winner run checkpoint (from comparison_report.md) -> models/egg_grader_resnet18_v1.pth (use best-candidate name if arch differs, note in winner.json). Verify: loads via model_factory with checkpoint arch metadata, class_names order ('Damaged','Not Damaged'). Re-run src/sweep_threshold.py against winner on VAL only -> refresh reports/damage_threshold.json so selected threshold matches winner. Write reports/experiments/winner.json {source_run, arch, strategy, seed, val_metrics, threshold, destination}. Test set still untouched.
acceptance_criteria: models/egg_grader_resnet18_v1.pth exists and loads via model_factory
Checkpoint has arch + arch_args + hyperparams metadata
validation: ./.venv/bin/python -c "import torch,json; ck=torch.load('models/egg_grader_resnet18_v1.pth',map_location='cpu'); assert 'arch' in ck and list(ck['class_names'])==['Damaged','Not Damaged'], ck.keys(); w=json.load(open('reports/experiments/winner.json')); t=json.load(open('reports/damage_threshold.json')); assert 0.50<=t['selected_threshold']<=0.95" && ./.venv/bin/python src/sweep_threshold.py --labels data/damage/manifests/val.csv --image-root . --checkpoint models/egg_grader_resnet18_v1.pth --output-csv reports/threshold_sweep.csv --output-json reports/damage_threshold.json
